name: Evans F. Carlson

roles.title: Executive Officer, 4th Marine Regiment / operations officer, 4th Marine Division

summary: Spent 1937–38 marching with the Chinese Eighth Route Army, came home convinced that a small unit could be led by explanation rather than by orders, and built the 2nd Marine Raider Battalion on the idea — including the phrase he brought back with him, *gung ho*. Took the battalion ashore on Makin in August 1942 and then on the thirty-day Long Patrol behind the Japanese lines on Guadalcanal that November. The Chinese years made him suspect to his own service for the rest of his life, and the Raider battalions were disbanded in 1944.
